title: Surge calibration: staffing and coverage tally (ad-hoc)
content:
What this is: lightweight, one-page tally to decide short-run coverage for upcoming marketing-driven surge window (2027-11-20 to 2027-11-28). Meant for quick owner allocation, fallback list, and immediate headcount asks. Not canonical rota; use as input to schedule tool.

Notes-to-self: this grew out of standup worry that Dedicated burst will outstrip predicted capacity (see OPS-4218). Keep it tight, leave TODOs inline.

--- SHEET (columns separated by | for quick copy) ---
Team | Primary owner | Backup | Location (region) | Avail window (UTC) | Expected capacity (rps) | Notes
Hosting API | Priya Singh | Anya Morales | us-west1 | 2027-11-20 00:00 - 2027-11-28 06:00 | 1200 | Priya to confirm burst autoscale policy; prefix-cache warm-up on 11/19
Dedicated pools | Marco Nguyen | Samir Rao | us-east1 | 2027-11-20 06:00 - 2027-11-28 18:00 | 800 | Certain customers pinned to v2-128; potential quota reassignments
Private deployments | Liam O'Connor | Mei Zhao | eu-west1 | 2027-11-21 00:00 - 2027-11-27 23:59 | 150 | Liaison list for enterprise SCIM + support escalation attached
SRE / Incident | Noor Patel | Daniel Ruiz | global | 2027-11-20 00:00 - 2027-11-28 23:59 | N/A | Triage lead rotation needed; on-call playbook link in artifacts
Solutions Eng (SE) | Priya Singh | Diego Alvarez | us-west1 | 2027-11-21 09:00 - 2027-11-25 17:00 | advisory | SEs for 1st-hour ramp calls; include runbook summary
Support (CS) | Amber Li | Tom Becker | global | 2027-11-20 06:00 - 2027-11-28 22:00 | ticket triage | Escalation matrix updated 2027-10-12
Networking / Infra | Marco Nguyen | Kelsey Park | us-east1 | 2027-11-20 00:00 - 2027-11-28 12:00 | 1 maintenance slot | Watch for egress spikes, tmp NAT pool reservations
Billing ops | Zoe Martinez | Rajiv Patel | global | 2027-11-22 08:00 - 2027-11-24 18:00 | billing window | Promo credits scheduled; monitor refund rate

--- QUICK GAP ANALYSIS ---
1) Overnight (00:00-06:00 UTC) coverage: Hosting API has primary but backup not fully confirmed. Ask: Priya -> confirm Anya's weekend availability by EOD 11/16.
2) Dedicated pool > capacity risk if two enterprise customers burst simultaneously. Action: Marco to request 100 GPU burst quota from capacity pool (ticket: INFRA-773).
3) Private deployments have low expected capacity; ensure SEs on-call for first-hour handoff for any enterprise spikes (Liam to confirm).
4) SRE rotation unclear for 11/26 (US Thanksgiving overlap): need volunteer or auto-fallback to global on-call.

--- ACTIONS / DECISIONS (short) ---
- Marco: open quota request + add to INFRA-773 (due 11/16).
- Priya: confirm backup coverage + publish mini-runbook (due 11/16).
- Liam: confirm enterprise liaison + attach SCIM contact list (due 11/17).
- Amber: prepare prewritten responses for top-5 expected issues (due 11/18).
- Evelyn (me): consolidate final tally and hand to scheduling tool (cc: product-ops) on 11/18 morning.

--- QUICK COMMUNICATION PLAN ---
- Primary coordination channel: #ops-coverage (Slack). Start daily standups 11/18 -> 11/28 09:30 UTC (15m).
- Incident escalation: Pager duty to SRE primary, then dedicated fallback.
- Customer comms: SE + CS to draft FAQ for top-3 probes and post to support portal 11/19.

--- NOTES ON DATA SOURCES ---
- Expected capacity numbers are rough; pulled from last three similar campaigns (internal sheet id: gdrive:1X-surges-2026-2027).
- SLOs: latency target 99p50 < 200ms for hosted API; prioritized for this window.

--- OPEN QUESTIONS ---
- Do we allow best-effort fallback to a lower-cost model (quantized variant) for non-critical customers during spikes? (product + research decision)
- Can billing ops accept automated promo refund thresholds for the window? Amber to confirm with finance.

--- TODOs (short checklist) ---
[ ] Priya confirm backup weekend availability (Anya)
[ ] Marco request GPU burst INFRA-773
[ ] Liam attach SCIM enterprise contacts
[ ] Amber draft support FAQ
[ ] Evelyn publish final tally to scheduling tool and ping #ops-coverage by 11/18 10:00 UTC

--- QUICK LINKS ---
• JIRA: OPS-4218 (surge prediction)
• INFRA-773 (quota request)
• Confluence: Oncall + Surge Playbook
• Support FAQ draft: gdrive:docs/surge-faq-draft-nov2027

Freeform thoughts / heuristics (notes to self): keep this small — fewer owners, clearer escalation. Avoid creating additional meeting burden for SEs (preferred short ad-hoc shifts). If quota request delayed, shift non-SLA traffic to lower-tier routing and prepare customer comms for rate-limits.

If you're reading: add your name to collaborators above and ping me in Slack (evelyn.chen) if you can take a backup slot.

-- end sheet --
